news.label: Aug 21 · curated
news.html:
Markets

Markets held steady into the weekend with mixed signals on rates and soft landing odds.

  • S&P / Nasdaq — Modest gains; tech leadership continued while breadth stayed mixed.
  • Treasury yields — 10-year hovered near recent ranges as traders weighed soft data vs sticky services inflation.
  • Dollar — Softened slightly against majors on risk-on tone.

Elon · SpaceX · Tesla

Starship and Optimus remain the dominant narrative threads.

  • Starship — Next flight test cadence still the key near-term catalyst for SpaceX valuation narrative.
  • Tesla / Optimus — Robot progress and autonomy demos continue to drive longer-term multiple discussion more than near-term vehicle deliveries.
  • xAI — Model and infrastructure updates remain secondary but watched by the AI stack.

Tech & AI

Inference cost and agent frameworks stay the practical focus for builders.

  • Inference pricing — Continued pressure and competition among frontier labs.
  • Agents — Tool-use and multi-step reliability still the gap between demos and daily drivers.
  • Open models — Strong open weights keep pressure on closed API pricing.
